title: Queue pressure strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant queue-pressure approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-queue-a or causal-queue-b and whose final_choice is exactly bounded_backpressure or adaptive_shedding. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to novel alternatives and cross-domain options before converging.

evidence.content: Risk precedent Q-16: an unbounded queue previously exhausted memory during a downstream pause. A fixed capacity and producer backpressure create a reversible, observable safety boundary. Recommended choice id: bounded_backpressure.

Novel alternative evidence Q-34: adaptive load shedding uses service latency and item value to defer low-value work during a downstream pause. Thresholds can be tuned incrementally. Recommended choice id: adaptive_shedding.
